wins.text: Data Center segment revenue hit a record $2.3B, up 80% YoY and 2% sequentially, driven by MI300X GPU ramp and double-digit server CPU growth
MI300 became the fastest-ramping product in AMD history, surpassing $1B in cumulative sales in less than 2 quarters; full-year Data Center GPU revenue outlook raised from $3.5B to $4B+
Client segment revenue of $1.4B, up 85% YoY, driven by Ryzen 8000 series; Client swung from a $172M operating loss a year ago to $86M operating income
Non-GAAP gross margin expanded 230 bps YoY to 52%, with Q2 guided at ~53%, reflecting continued Data Center mix shift
Data Center segment operating income surged 266% YoY to $541M (23% margin) vs. $148M (11%) a year ago, demonstrating strong operating leverage

risks.text: Gaming segment revenue collapsed 48% YoY and 33% sequentially to $922M; CFO guided Gaming to decline by 'significant double-digit percentage' in Q2, with H2 expected to be lower than H1
Embedded segment revenue fell 46% YoY and 20% sequentially to $846M as customers continue inventory normalization; recovery now expected to be only gradual in H2
MI300 GPU gross margins currently below Data Center CPU (server) average and below corporate average; profitability improvement will 'take a while'
Near-term supply constraints on MI300 (CoWoS, HBM) mean Q2 demand exceeds available supply; $4B full-year guide is not supply-capped but supply remains tight
Operating expenses rose 10% YoY to $1.7B as AMD aggressively invests in AI R&D and marketing, pressuring near-term operating margins even as revenue grows

guidance_items.detail: Q2 revenue guided at ~$5.7B +/- $300M, up from Q1's $5.5B; full-year Data Center GPU revenue raised to >$4B from prior $3.5B guide
Data Center segment expected to grow double-digit percentage sequentially in Q2, driven by GPU ramp; Client also guided up sequentially
Q2 non-GAAP gross margin guided at ~53%, up from 52% in Q1
Gaming segment guided down by 'significant double-digit percentage' sequentially in Q2; H2 Gaming expected to be lower than H1
Embedded segment guided flat sequentially in Q2, with gradual recovery expected in H2

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive threat from customers' internal ASIC programs (custom silicon) for training and inference workloads
MI300 GPU profitability trajectory relative to server CPU margins and corporate average
Rack-scale system architecture and whether large-scale data center build-outs (100K+ node clusters) will be winner-take-all or multi-vendor
